description: Marketo create bulk activity extract through the registered credential and vendor RBAC. Dispatches a platform job; poll check_marketo_job_status for its vendor response. Preserve batchId/exportId for vendor status calls; platform completion does not mean the vendor bulk job is complete.

result_processor_customizations.action_label: Marketo: Create Bulk Activity Extract job dispatched
result_processor_customizations.result_description: Queued platform job_id and status; poll check_marketo_job_status for the vendor response. Vendor bulk completion is separate.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Preserve vendor ids, status, warnings/errors and continuation hints. Bulk downloads include body_base64 and content_range; file metadata reads produce a workspace TSV.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Marketo create bulk activity extract through the registered credential and vendor RBAC. Dispatches a platform job; poll check_marketo_job_status for its vendor response. Preserve batchId/exportId for vendor status calls; platform completion does not mean the vendor bulk job is complete.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: marketo.invalid_params: correct the documented input. marketo.permission_denied/auth_failed: credential or vendor RBAC refused. marketo.validation_failed: vendor rejected the operation.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: Read back before retrying uncertain writes. Vendor RBAC controls access. No confirmation prompt, invented endpoint, local role restriction or automatic mutation retry.
